# Path scenes for the golden images (src/draw/paths_golden.zig draws them, make.py makes the
# references). `scene NAME W H` starts a canvas; `fill RULE RRGGBBAA` starts a shape filled
# under RULE (nonzero, even_odd), or `stroke WIDTH JOIN CAP MITER_LIMIT RRGGBBAA` a stroked one
# (JOIN miter, round, bevel; CAP butt, round, square); then path verbs, SVG letters, absolute
# coordinates. `tvg NAME X Y SCALE` draws every command of the TinyVG file NAME.tvg (tvg.py
# describes and encodes it) at X, Y, SCALE px per display unit.
#
# M x y, L x y, Q cx cy x y, C c0x c0y c1x c1y x y, Z.

scene lines 48 48
fill nonzero ffffffff
M 3.3 4.1
L 21.7 6.2
L 9.4 22.8
Z
fill nonzero ff8040ff
M 33.5 18.6
L 41.494 43.203
L 20.566 27.997
L 46.434 27.997
L 25.506 43.203
Z
fill even_odd 60c0ffc0
M 14.2 23.4
L 20.842 43.842
L 3.453 31.208
L 24.947 31.208
L 7.558 43.842
Z

scene quads 48 48
fill nonzero ffffffff
M 6.2 40.5
Q 8 6 41.3 7.4
Q 38 41 6.2 40.5
Z
fill nonzero 202020ff
M 14.5 30.25
Q 24 24 33 15.5
Q 20 18 14.5 30.25
Z

scene cubics 48 48
fill nonzero ff4060ff
M 24 41.3
C 4 28 6.5 8 24 16.5
C 41.5 8 44 28 24 41.3
Z
fill nonzero ffffff80
M 2.5 45.5
C 15 30 33 60 45.5 2.5
L 45.5 45.5
Z

C 12.2 11.226 15.826 7.6 20.3 7.6
C 24.774 7.6 28.4 11.226 28.4 15.7
Z
fill even_odd ffffffff
M 52.9 16.2
C 52.9 21.391 48.691 25.6 43.5 25.6
C 38.309 25.6 34.1 21.391 34.1 16.2
C 34.1 11.009 38.309 6.8 43.5 6.8

Z

# One zigzag per join, caps along the bottom; the sharp turn of the last zigzag passes the
# miter limit and bevels.
scene joins 96 64
stroke 5 miter butt 4 ffffffff
M 6.5 22
L 18 6.3
L 29.5 22
L 41 6.3
stroke 5 round butt 4 ff9050ff
M 52.5 22
L 64 6.3
L 75.5 22
L 87 6.3
stroke 4.5 bevel butt 4 60c0ffff
M 6.5 30.5
L 30 34
L 8 39.25
stroke 4.5 miter butt 2 c0ff60ff
M 50.5 30.5
L 90 34
L 52 39.25
stroke 6 miter butt 4 ffffffff
M 10.5 52
L 26 52
stroke 6 miter round 4 ffffffff
M 40.5 52
L 56 52
stroke 6 miter square 4 ffffffff
M 70.5 52
L 86 52

# Curves and closed contours: a cubic with round caps, a closed quadratic loop with miters, a
# translucent rectangle whose stroke overlaps itself, and a dot.
scene strokes 96 64
stroke 3.5 round round 4 ff7090ff
M 6.2 56
C 20 -10 40 90 58 10.5
stroke 2.25 miter butt 4 80ffb0ff
M 64.5 8
Q 92 8 90 30
Q 70 34 64.5 8
Z
stroke 7 bevel butt 4 ffffff80
M 60.5 40.5
L 90.2 40.5
L 90.2 58.3
L 60.5 58.3
Z
stroke 5 round round 4 ffd040ff
M 30.3 50.7
L 30.3 50.7

# TinyVG icons (tvg.py): every command and style, three unit sizes and colour encodings.
scene icons 112 64
tvg icon_all 2 2 2.5
tvg icon_565 66 2 2.5
tvg icon_f32 66 44 1.25
tvg icon_565 90 44 1
